name: Alaska Butcher Equipment & Supply Inc.
old_description: We ship quality equipment throughout Alaska and to the contiguous 48 states.
about:
Alaska Butcher Equipment & Supply operates from Anchorage, Alaska, where it has served hunters, anglers, and commercial processors since its founding. The business is owned by Butch, who is frequently mentioned by customers as the face of the company. While the exact founding year is not publicly stated, the store has become a fixture at sportsman's shows across the state.

The company stocks a wide range of vacuum packaging machines and supplies—including chamber vacuum packers, suction sealers, and bags from brands such as Magic Vac, Flaem, and Mini-Pack—alongside meat-processing equipment: grinders, saws, stuffers, mixers, slicers, tenderizers, and smokers. It also carries sausage-making ingredients (casings, cures, seasonings, high-temperature cheese), packaging materials, protective gear, and branded apparel. In addition to sales, the shop provides equipment servicing and short-term rentals.

Customers span home users preserving wild game and fish, as well as small-scale commercial butchers and seafood processors throughout Alaska and the lower 48 states. Testimonials reference purchases of vacuum sealers, sausage stuffers, and smokers, and note the company's presence at Alaska sportsman's shows where it offers event pricing.

The company emphasizes that it stocks only quality products, stands behind what it sells, and provides friendly service with statewide and nationwide shipping. The rental and servicing programs are positioned as a way to support customers who need temporary capacity or maintenance on their equipment.
